verses.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ੧੦ : ਗੁਰਮੁਖ ਸਭ ਤੋਂ ਉੱਚੇ ਹਨ
verses.translit_en: pauRee 10 : gurmukh sabh to(n) u'che han

verses.gurmukhi: ਚਿੰਤਾਮਣਿ ਚਿੰਤਾ ਹਰੈ ਕਾਮਧੇਨੁ ਕਾਮਨਾਂ ਪੁਜਾਏ।
verses.translit_en: chi(n)taaman chi(n)taa harai kaamadhen kaamanaa(n) pujaae|

en.bdb: Chintamani alleviates anxieties and wish-fulfilling cow (kamadhena) fulfils all desires.

verses.gurmukhi: ਫਲ ਫੁਲਿ ਦੇਂਦਾ ਪਾਰਜਾਤੁ ਰਿਧਿ ਸਿਧਿ ਨਵ ਨਾਥ ਲੁਭਾਏ।
verses.translit_en: fal ful dhe(n)dhaa paarajaat ridh sidh nav naath lubhaae|

en.bdb: Parijat tree gives flowers and fruits and the nine naths are engrossed with the miraculous powers.

verses.gurmukhi: ਦਸ ਅਵਤਾਰ ਅਕਾਰ ਕਰਿ ਪੁਰਖਾਰਥ ਕਰਿ ਨਾਂਵ ਗਣਾਏ।
verses.translit_en: dhas avataar akaar kar purakhaarath kar naa(n)v ganaae|

en.bdb: The ten incarnations (of Hindu mythology) assumed human body and showed their valour to spread their names.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਖ ਫਲੁ ਸਾਧਸੰਗੁ ਚਾਰਿ ਪਦਾਰਥ ਸੇਵਾ ਲਾਏ।
verses.translit_en: gurmukh sukh fal saadhasa(n)g chaar padhaarath sevaa laae|

en.bdb: The pleasure fruit of the gurmukhs is the holy congregation wherein all the four ideals of life (dharma, arth, kam and moks) serve themselves.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਬਦੁ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਲਿਵ ਪਿਰਮ ਰਸੁ ਅਕਥ ਕਹਾਣੀ ਕਥੀ ਨ ਜਾਏ।
verses.translit_en: sabadh surat liv piram ras akath kahaanee kathee na jaae|

en.bdb: The consciousness of gurmukhs there remains merged in the Word and the story of their love is ineffable.

verses.gurmukhi: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਪੂਰਨ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਭਗਤਿ ਵਛਲ ਹੁਇ ਅਛਲ ਛਲਾਏੇ।
verses.translit_en: paarabraham pooran braham bhagat vachhal hui achhal chhalaaee|

en.bdb: The transcendental Brahm is the perfect Brahm who by becoming affectionate to devotees puts many deceitful persons in the web of deception.
The Lord is free from all accounts and none can understand His mystery.
